intro: Saint Lucia is a parliamentary democracy with the British monarch as head of state.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister leads the government; Philip J. Pierre has led since 2021. Parliament has an elected House of Assembly and an appointed Senate.

chapters.title: Regional ties
text: Saint Lucia hosts the headquarters of the Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States.

keyTerms.meaning: A country sharing the British monarch.
